packageRules.description: go-proton-api is tracked by master pseudo-version; its old v0.1.x tags are older code (see #48).
The ProtonMail/resty replace must match the commit go-proton-api builds against; it moves with go-proton-api, not on its own (see #33).

gopenpgp and go-crypto stay on the -proton builds. The plain build of the same number sorts higher but is different code (no forwarding keys, no decompression limit), so only -proton versions are offered. ignoreUnstable is off because Renovate reads -proton as a pre-release.
gluon is tracked by dev pseudo-version, like go-proton-api: its newest tag, v0.17.0, sorts higher than the pseudo-version and is older code.
